title: Normal Chests
intro: Normal Chests are blue coin-purchased chests that are one of the most accessible chest types in the game. They can be bought with coins, or obtained for free through quests, leveling up, and daily login rewards.
obtaining_body: Normal Chests can be purchased with coins from the shop. They are also awarded for free by completing quests, reaching new player levels, and through daily login rewards. The coin cost of a Normal Chest scales with your player level.
cost_body: The cost of a Normal Chest is your current player level multiplied by 250 coins. For example, at level 1 a chest costs 250 coins, at level 10 it costs 2,500 coins, and at level 70 it costs 17,500 coins.
contents_body: Normal Chests contain two types of items: enclosure puzzle pieces and ready-to-place zoo decorations. This makes them unique among the free-to-obtain chest types, as they can directly provide decorations for your zoo without requiring puzzle completion.
special_items_title: Special Diamond Items as Puzzle Pieces
special_items_body: Normal Chests also contain puzzle pieces for a small number of items that are typically only available for diamonds. These can be assembled into the item for free by collecting enough pieces:
animals_body: Normal Chests contain puzzle pieces for most regular Shop Animals across all biomes, spanning Common through Legendary rarity. The Howler Monkey and all animals exclusive to diamond chests are not included.
tips_body: Normal Chests are an excellent source of ready-to-place zoo decorations, making them great for building out your zoo. The special diamond items available as puzzle pieces — including the Animal Carousel — represent significant value, so collecting Normal Chests consistently is worthwhile even at higher levels.
